records.literal_gloss: And spoke Yahweh to Moses, saying,

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} spoke to Moses, saying,
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} spoke to Moses. He said,

es.L: Y habló {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} a Moisés, diciendo:
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} habló a Moisés. Le dijo:

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} parla à Moïse, en disant :
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} parla à Moïse. Il dit :

decisions.choice: saying: introduces the words that follow
decisions.reason: The usual opening of a speech from God in Leviticus, as in 1:1. The speech runs to the end of the chapter.

decisions.choice: passé simple at Literal and Balanced ("parla", "dit"); passé composé at Readable ("a dit")
decisions.reason: As in the rest of Leviticus, the short narrative frame follows the French tense by level; the law that follows is in the future or uses "devoir".

source.text: דַּבֵּ֞ר אֶל־בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר אִשָּׁה֙ כִּ֣י תַזְרִ֔יעַ וְיָלְדָ֖ה זָכָ֑ר וְטָֽמְאָה֙ שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֔ים כִּימֵ֛י נִדַּ֥ת דְּוֺתָ֖הּ תִּטְמָֽא׃

records.literal_gloss: Speak to [the] sons of Israel, saying, a woman when she conceives and bears a male, and she will be unclean seven days; as [the] days of [the] impurity of her menstruation she will be unclean.

en.L: "Speak to the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel, saying, 'When a woman conceives and bears a male, she will be unclean seven days; as [in] the days of the impurity of her menstruation she will be unclean.
en.B: "Speak to the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} and tell them: 'When a woman becomes pregnant and gives birth to a boy, she will be unclean for seven days. She will be unclean just as she is during her monthly period.
en.R: "Tell the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}}: 'A woman who has a baby boy will be unclean for seven days. It is the same as when she has her monthly period.

es.L: «Habla a los hijos de Israel, diciendo: “Cuando una mujer conciba y dé a luz un varón, será impura siete días; como en los días de la impureza de su menstruación será impura.
es.B: «Habla a los israelitas y diles: “Cuando una mujer quede embarazada y dé a luz un niño, quedará impura durante siete días. Será impura igual que durante su menstruación.
es.R: «Diles a los israelitas: “Una mujer que tiene un bebé varón quedará impura durante siete días. Es lo mismo que cuando tiene la menstruación.

fr.L: « Parle aux {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël, en disant : “Lorsqu’une femme concevra et enfantera un enfant mâle, elle sera impure sept jours ; comme aux jours de l’impureté de ses règles, elle sera impure.
fr.B: « Parle aux {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} et dis-leur : “Quand une femme sera enceinte et mettra au monde un garçon, elle sera impure pendant sept jours. Elle sera impure comme pendant ses règles.
fr.R: « Dis aux {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} : “Une femme qui a un petit garçon sera impure pendant sept jours. C’est comme quand elle a ses règles.

sw.L: "Sema na wana wa Israeli, ukisema, 'Mwanamke akichukua mimba na kuzaa mtoto wa kiume, atakuwa najisi siku saba; kama siku za unajisi wa hedhi yake atakuwa najisi.
sw.B: "Sema na Waisraeli, uwaambie, 'Mwanamke akipata mimba na kuzaa mtoto wa kiume, atakuwa najisi kwa siku saba. Atakuwa najisi kama wakati wa hedhi yake ya kila mwezi.
sw.R: "Waambie Waisraeli, 'Mwanamke anayezaa mtoto wa kiume atakuwa najisi kwa siku saba. Ni sawa na wakati anapokuwa katika hedhi yake ya kila mwezi.

decisions.choice: conceives: becomes pregnant
decisions.reason: The verb is related to the word for seed and means to produce offspring, here to conceive a child. With "and bears" it covers the whole of pregnancy and birth.

decisions.choice: unclean: ritually impure, not sinful or dirty
decisions.reason: Unclean is a state that keeps a person away from holy things and the sanctuary for a time (verse 4); it is not a sin or a punishment for having a child (see 5:2; 11:4). Birth, like other flows of blood from the body (chapter 15), brings this state, and it ends with time and an offering (verses 6-8).

decisions.choice: the impurity of her menstruation: the monthly period
decisions.reason: The bleeding after birth is treated like the uncleanness of a woman's monthly period, whose rules are given in 15:19-24. For these first seven days she is unclean in the same way, and so is what she lies or sits on.

decisions.choice: a boy
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "a male"; Balanced and Readable say "a boy", as verse 3 shows he is a son.

records.literal_gloss: And on the day the eighth will be circumcised [the] flesh of his foreskin.

en.L: And on the eighth day the flesh of his foreskin will be circumcised.
en.B: On the eighth day the boy is to be circumcised.
en.R: On the eighth day the baby boy must be circumcised.

es.L: Y al día octavo será circuncidada la carne de su prepucio.
es.B: Al octavo día el niño será circuncidado.
es.R: Al octavo día hay que circuncidar al niño.

fr.L: Et le huitième jour, la chair de son prépuce sera circoncise.
fr.B: Le huitième jour, l’enfant sera circoncis.
fr.R: Le huitième jour, il faut circoncire le petit garçon.

sw.L: Na siku ya nane nyama ya govi lake itatahiriwa.
sw.B: Siku ya nane mtoto huyo atatahiriwa.
sw.R: Siku ya nane lazima mtoto huyo atahiriwe.

decisions.choice: circumcised on the eighth day: the sign of the covenant
decisions.reason: God gave circumcision to Abraham as the sign of his covenant, to be done on every boy at eight days old (Genesis 17:10-12; 21:4). The law of birth sets it beside the mother's seven days of uncleanness: when they end, the boy is circumcised.

decisions.choice: the boy is to be circumcised
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "the flesh of his foreskin". Balanced and Readable say only that the boy is circumcised, which is what the phrase means.

source.text: וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים יוֹם֙ וּשְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת יָמִ֔ים תֵּשֵׁ֖ב בִּדְמֵ֣י טָהֳרָ֑ה בְּכָל־קֹ֣דֶשׁ לֹֽא־תִגָּ֗ע וְאֶל־הַמִּקְדָּשׁ֙ לֹ֣א תָבֹ֔א עַד־מְלֹ֖את יְמֵ֥י טָהֳרָֽהּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And thirty day[s] and three days she will remain in [the] blood of purification; any holy thing not she will touch, and into the sanctuary not she will go, until are completed [the] days of her purification.

en.L: And thirty-three days she will remain in [the] blood of purification; she will not touch any holy thing, and she will not come into the sanctuary until the days of her purification are completed.
en.B: She is then to remain thirty-three days in the time of her blood purification. Until those days are over, she must not touch anything holy or come into the sanctuary.
en.R: Then for thirty-three more days her bleeding is being made clean. During that time she must not touch anything that is holy. She must not go into the holy tent until those days are over.

es.L: Y treinta y tres días permanecerá en [la] sangre de purificación; no tocará ninguna cosa santa, y no entrará en el santuario hasta que se cumplan los días de su purificación.
es.B: Después permanecerá treinta y tres días en el tiempo de purificación de su sangre. Hasta que terminen esos días, no tocará nada santo ni entrará en el santuario.
es.R: Luego, durante treinta y tres días más, su sangrado se va purificando. Durante ese tiempo no debe tocar nada santo. No debe entrar en la tienda santa hasta que terminen esos días.

fr.L: Et trente-trois jours elle demeurera dans [le] sang de la purification ; elle ne touchera aucune chose sainte, et elle n’entrera pas dans le sanctuaire jusqu’à ce que soient accomplis les jours de sa purification.
fr.B: Elle restera ensuite trente-trois jours dans le temps de la purification de son sang. Jusqu’à la fin de ces jours, elle ne touchera rien de saint et n’entrera pas dans le sanctuaire.
fr.R: Ensuite, pendant trente-trois jours de plus, ses pertes de sang sont en train de se purifier. Pendant ce temps, elle ne doit toucher à rien de saint. Elle ne doit pas entrer dans la tente sainte avant la fin de ces jours.

sw.L: Na siku thelathini na tatu atakaa katika damu ya kusafishwa; hatagusa kitu chochote kitakatifu, wala hataingia mahali patakatifu mpaka siku za kusafishwa kwake zitimie.
sw.B: Kisha atakaa siku thelathini na tatu katika kipindi cha kusafishwa damu yake. Mpaka siku hizo zitakapokwisha, asiguse kitu chochote kitakatifu wala asiingie mahali patakatifu.
sw.R: Kisha kwa siku thelathini na tatu zaidi damu yake inasafishwa. Wakati huo lazima asiguse kitu chochote kitakatifu. Asiingie katika hema takatifu mpaka siku hizo ziishe.

decisions.choice: blood of purification: the bleeding of the weeks after birth, a time of becoming clean
decisions.reason: The phrase names the later bleeding after a birth as part of her purification. After the first seven days her uncleanness is lighter: it is no longer like that of her monthly period, and the rules here forbid only holy things and the sanctuary. When the days are over she brings her offerings (verse 6).

decisions.choice: any holy thing: food or objects set apart for God
decisions.reason: Holy things include the priests' portions of the offerings and other sacred food (7:19-21; 22:3-7), which an unclean person must not touch.

decisions.choice: the sanctuary: the holy place of God's dwelling
decisions.reason: Here the sanctuary is the tabernacle and its court (see 19:30). An unclean person must not come into it (15:31).

decisions.choice: the holy tent
decisions.reason: Readable explains "the sanctuary" as the holy tent, the tabernacle where God was worshiped.

source.text: וְאִם־נְקֵבָ֣ה תֵלֵ֔ד וְטָמְאָ֥ה שְׁבֻעַ֖יִם כְּנִדָּתָ֑הּ וְשִׁשִּׁ֥ים יוֹם֙ וְשֵׁ֣שֶׁת יָמִ֔ים תֵּשֵׁ֖ב עַל־דְּמֵ֥י טָהֳרָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And if a female she bears, and she will be unclean two weeks, as [in] her menstruation; and sixty day[s] and six days she will remain in [the] blood of purification.

en.L: And if she bears a female, she will be unclean two weeks, as [in] her menstruation; and sixty-six days she will remain in [the] blood of purification.
en.B: If she gives birth to a girl, she will be unclean for two weeks, as she is during her monthly period. She is then to remain sixty-six days in the time of her blood purification.
en.R: If she has a baby girl, she will be unclean for two weeks, as she is during her monthly period. Then for sixty-six more days her bleeding is being made clean.

es.L: Y si da a luz una hembra, será impura dos semanas, como en su menstruación; y sesenta y seis días permanecerá en [la] sangre de purificación.
es.B: Si da a luz una niña, quedará impura durante dos semanas, como durante su menstruación. Después permanecerá sesenta y seis días en el tiempo de purificación de su sangre.
es.R: Si tiene una niña, quedará impura durante dos semanas, como cuando tiene la menstruación. Luego, durante sesenta y seis días más, su sangrado se va purificando.

fr.L: Et si elle enfante une fille, elle sera impure deux semaines, comme [lors de] ses règles ; et soixante-six jours elle demeurera dans [le] sang de la purification.
fr.B: Si elle met au monde une fille, elle sera impure pendant deux semaines, comme pendant ses règles. Elle restera ensuite soixante-six jours dans le temps de la purification de son sang.
fr.R: Si elle a une petite fille, elle sera impure pendant deux semaines, comme quand elle a ses règles. Ensuite, pendant soixante-six jours de plus, ses pertes de sang sont en train de se purifier.

sw.L: Na kama akizaa mtoto wa kike, atakuwa najisi wiki mbili, kama [wakati wa] hedhi yake; na siku sitini na sita atakaa katika damu ya kusafishwa.
sw.B: Akizaa mtoto wa kike, atakuwa najisi kwa wiki mbili, kama wakati wa hedhi yake. Kisha atakaa siku sitini na sita katika kipindi cha kusafishwa damu yake.
sw.R: Akizaa mtoto wa kike, atakuwa najisi kwa wiki mbili, kama wakati wa hedhi yake. Kisha kwa siku sitini na sita zaidi damu yake inasafishwa.

decisions.choice: two weeks ... sixty-six days: each period doubled for a daughter
decisions.reason: For a girl both periods are twice as long as for a boy: fourteen and sixty-six days, eighty in all, against seven and thirty-three, forty in all. The law does not give the reason. Some link it to the boy's circumcision on the eighth day, which ends the mother's first period; others to the daughter who will one day bear children herself. Either way the offering at the end is the same for a son or a daughter (verse 6).

decisions.choice: blood of purification: as in verse 4
decisions.reason: The same phrase as in verse 4.

source.text: וּבִמְלֹ֣את׀יְמֵ֣י טָהֳרָ֗הּ לְבֵן֮ א֣וֹ לְבַת֒ תָּבִ֞יא כֶּ֤בֶשׂ בֶּן־שְׁנָתוֹ֙ לְעֹלָ֔ה וּבֶן־יוֹנָ֥ה אוֹ־תֹ֖ר לְחַטָּ֑את אֶל־פֶּ֥תַח אֹֽהֶל־מוֹעֵ֖ד אֶל־הַכֹּהֵֽן׃

records.literal_gloss: And when are completed [the] days of her purification for a son or for a daughter, she will bring a lamb, a son of its year, for a burnt offering, and a young one of a dove or a turtledove for a sin offering, to [the] entrance of [the] tent of meeting, to the priest.

en.L: And when the days of her purification are completed, for a son or for a daughter, she will bring a lamb a year old for a burnt offering, and a young pigeon or a turtledove for a sin offering, to the entrance of the tent of meeting, to the priest.
en.B: When the days of her purification are over, whether for a son or a daughter, she is to bring to the priest, at the entrance of the tent of meeting, a lamb a year old for a burnt offering and a young pigeon or a turtledove for a sin offering.
en.R: When her time of being made clean is over, whether she had a son or a daughter, she must bring two animals to the priest at the entrance of the meeting tent. She must bring a lamb one year old for a burnt offering. And she must bring a young pigeon or a turtledove for a sin offering.

es.L: Y cuando se cumplan los días de su purificación, por hijo o por hija, traerá un cordero de un año para holocausto, y un pichón o una tórtola para sacrificio por el pecado, a la entrada de la Tienda del Encuentro, al sacerdote.
es.B: Cuando terminen los días de su purificación, sea por un hijo o por una hija, llevará al sacerdote, a la entrada de la Tienda del Encuentro, un cordero de un año para holocausto y un pichón o una tórtola como sacrificio por el pecado.
es.R: Cuando termine su tiempo de purificación, haya tenido un hijo o una hija, tiene que llevar dos animales al sacerdote, a la entrada de la Tienda del Encuentro. Tiene que llevar un cordero de un año para un holocausto. Y tiene que llevar un pichón o una paloma para un sacrificio por el pecado.

fr.L: Et quand les jours de sa purification seront accomplis, pour un fils ou pour une fille, elle amènera un agneau d’un an pour l’holocauste, et un jeune pigeon ou une tourterelle pour le sacrifice pour le péché, à l’entrée de la tente de la Rencontre, au prêtre.
fr.B: Quand les jours de sa purification seront terminés, que ce soit pour un fils ou pour une fille, elle amènera au prêtre, à l’entrée de la tente de la Rencontre, un agneau d’un an pour l’holocauste et un jeune pigeon ou une tourterelle pour le sacrifice pour le péché.
fr.R: Quand son temps de purification est fini, qu’elle ait eu un fils ou une fille, elle doit amener deux animaux au prêtre, à l’entrée de la tente de la Rencontre. Elle doit amener un agneau d’un an pour un holocauste. Et elle doit amener un jeune pigeon ou une colombe pour un sacrifice pour le péché.

sw.L: Na siku za kusafishwa kwake zitakapotimia, kwa ajili ya mwana au binti, ataleta mwanakondoo wa mwaka mmoja kuwa sadaka ya kuteketezwa, na kinda la njiwa au hua kuwa sadaka ya dhambi, mlangoni pa Hema la Kukutania, kwa kuhani.
sw.B: Siku za kusafishwa kwake zitakapokwisha, akiwa amezaa mwana au binti, atamletea kuhani, kwenye mlango wa Hema la Kukutania, mwanakondoo wa mwaka mmoja kuwa sadaka ya kuteketezwa na kinda la njiwa au hua kuwa sadaka ya dhambi.
sw.R: Wakati wake wa kusafishwa ukiisha, awe amezaa mwana au binti, lazima amletee kuhani wanyama wawili kwenye mlango wa Hema la Kukutania. Lazima alete mwanakondoo wa mwaka mmoja kuwa sadaka ya kuteketezwa. Na lazima alete kinda la njiwa au hua kuwa sadaka ya dhambi.

decisions.choice: a son of its year: a lamb in its first year
decisions.reason: "A son of its year" means a year old or younger, a young male lamb (as in 9:3; 23:12).

decisions.choice: burnt offering ... sin offering: the two offerings that end her uncleanness
decisions.reason: The burnt offering is wholly given to God (1:3). The sin offering cleanses (4:3): here no sin of the mother is in view, but the uncleanness of the birth, which the offering removes so that she may again come to the sanctuary.

decisions.choice: a young pigeon or a turtledove: the birds named in 1:14
decisions.reason: "A young one of a dove" is a young pigeon; the turtledove is a smaller wild dove. They are the birds allowed for offerings in 1:14 and 5:7.

decisions.choice: two animals
decisions.reason: Readable says first that she brings two animals and then names each one, to break up the long sentence.

source.text: וְהִקְרִיב֞וֹ לִפְנֵ֤י יְהוָה֙ וְכִפֶּ֣ר עָלֶ֔יהָ וְטָהֲרָ֖ה מִמְּקֹ֣ר דָּמֶ֑יהָ זֹ֤את תּוֹרַת֙ הַיֹּלֶ֔דֶת לַזָּכָ֖ר א֥וֹ לַנְּקֵבָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And he will present it before Yahweh and make atonement for her, and she will be clean from [the] spring of her blood. This [is the] law of the [one] bearing, for the male or for the female.

en.L: And he will present it before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and make atonement for her, and she will be clean from the source of her blood. This [is] the law of the [woman] who bears, for the male or for the female.
en.B: He is to present it before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and make atonement for her, and then she will be clean from her flow of blood. This is the law for a woman who gives birth to a boy or a girl.
en.R: The priest must offer it to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and make atonement for her. Then she will be clean from her bleeding. These are the rules for a woman who has a baby, a boy or a girl.

es.L: Y él lo presentará delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y hará expiación por ella, y quedará pura de la fuente de su sangre. Esta [es] la ley de la [mujer] que da a luz, para varón o para hembra.
es.B: El sacerdote lo presentará delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y hará expiación por ella, y entonces quedará pura de su flujo de sangre. Esta es la ley para la mujer que da a luz un niño o una niña.
es.R: El sacerdote tiene que ofrecerlo {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} y hacer expiación por ella. Entonces quedará pura de su sangrado. Estas son las normas para la mujer que tiene un bebé, sea niño o niña.

fr.L: Et il le présentera devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} et fera l’expiation pour elle, et elle sera pure de la source de son sang. Telle [est] la loi de [la femme] qui enfante, pour un garçon ou pour une fille.
fr.B: Le prêtre le présentera devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} et fera l’expiation pour elle ; alors elle sera pure de son flux de sang. Telle est la loi pour la femme qui met au monde un garçon ou une fille.
fr.R: Le prêtre doit l’offrir {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} et faire l’expiation pour elle. Alors elle sera pure de ses pertes de sang. Voilà les règles pour une femme qui a un bébé, garçon ou fille.

sw.L: Naye atamtoa mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na kufanya upatanisho kwa ajili yake, naye atakuwa safi kutoka chemchemi ya damu yake. Hii [ndiyo] sheria ya [mwanamke] anayezaa, kwa mtoto wa kiume au wa kike.
sw.B: Kuhani atamtoa mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na kumfanyia upatanisho, naye atakuwa safi kutokana na kutoka damu kwake. Hii ndiyo sheria kwa mwanamke anayezaa mtoto wa kiume au wa kike.
sw.R: Kuhani lazima amtoe kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na kumfanyia upatanisho. Ndipo atakuwa safi kutokana na kutoka damu kwake. Hizi ndizo kanuni kwa mwanamke anayezaa mtoto, wa kiume au wa kike.

decisions.choice: make atonement for her: remove her uncleanness so she may come near God
decisions.reason: To make atonement (1:4) here is to cleanse the mother from the uncleanness of birth, which is not a sin. The offerings restore her to the worship of God's people.

decisions.choice: the spring of her blood: the source of her bleeding
decisions.reason: A spring or fountain is a source of flowing water; here it is the source of the woman's bleeding (as in 20:18).

decisions.choice: law: instruction for one case
decisions.reason: The word means teaching or instruction. In Leviticus "this is the law of ..." ends the rules on one subject (6:2; 7:37; 11:46; 13:59).

decisions.choice: The priest
decisions.reason: Readable names the priest as the one who offers the animal.

source.text: וְאִם־לֹ֨א תִמְצָ֣א יָדָהּ֮ דֵּ֣י שֶׂה֒ וְלָקְחָ֣ה שְׁתֵּֽי־תֹרִ֗ים א֤וֹ שְׁנֵי֙ בְּנֵ֣י יוֹנָ֔ה אֶחָ֥ד לְעֹלָ֖ה וְאֶחָ֣ד לְחַטָּ֑את וְכִפֶּ֥ר עָלֶ֛יהָ הַכֹּהֵ֖ן וְטָהֵֽרָה׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And if not finds her hand [the] sufficiency of a lamb, and she will take two turtledoves or two young ones of a dove, one for a burnt offering and one for a sin offering; and will make atonement for her the priest, and she will be clean.

en.L: And if her hand does not find enough for a lamb, she will take two turtledoves or two young pigeons, one for a burnt offering and one for a sin offering; and the priest will make atonement for her, and she will be clean.'"
en.B: If she cannot afford a lamb, she is to take two turtledoves or two young pigeons, one for a burnt offering and the other for a sin offering. The priest will make atonement for her, and she will be clean.'"
en.R: A woman may not have enough money for a lamb. Then she must bring two turtledoves or two young pigeons. One is for a burnt offering, and the other is for a sin offering. The priest will make atonement for her, and she will be clean.'"

es.L: Y si su mano no halla lo suficiente para un cordero, tomará dos tórtolas o dos pichones, uno para holocausto y otro para sacrificio por el pecado; y el sacerdote hará expiación por ella, y quedará pura”».
es.B: Si no le alcanza para un cordero, tomará dos tórtolas o dos pichones, uno para holocausto y el otro para sacrificio por el pecado. El sacerdote hará expiación por ella, y quedará pura”».
es.R: Puede ser que una mujer no tenga suficiente dinero para un cordero. Entonces tiene que llevar dos palomas o dos pichones. Uno es para un holocausto, y el otro para un sacrificio por el pecado. El sacerdote hará expiación por ella, y quedará pura”».

fr.L: Et si sa main ne trouve pas de quoi [se procurer] un agneau, elle prendra deux tourterelles ou deux jeunes pigeons, l’un pour l’holocauste et l’autre pour le sacrifice pour le péché ; et le prêtre fera l’expiation pour elle, et elle sera pure.” »
fr.B: Si elle n’a pas les moyens d’offrir un agneau, elle prendra deux tourterelles ou deux jeunes pigeons, l’un pour l’holocauste et l’autre pour le sacrifice pour le péché. Le prêtre fera l’expiation pour elle, et elle sera pure.” »
fr.R: Une femme n’a peut-être pas assez d’argent pour un agneau. Alors elle doit amener deux colombes ou deux jeunes pigeons. L’un est pour un holocauste, et l’autre pour un sacrifice pour le péché. Le prêtre fera l’expiation pour elle, et elle sera pure.” »

sw.L: Na kama mkono wake hautapata [kiasi] cha kutosha mwanakondoo, atachukua hua wawili au makinda mawili ya njiwa, mmoja kuwa sadaka ya kuteketezwa na mmoja kuwa sadaka ya dhambi; na kuhani atafanya upatanisho kwa ajili yake, naye atakuwa safi.'"
sw.B: Kama hawezi kumudu mwanakondoo, atachukua hua wawili au makinda mawili ya njiwa, mmoja kuwa sadaka ya kuteketezwa na mwingine kuwa sadaka ya dhambi. Kuhani atamfanyia upatanisho, naye atakuwa safi.'"
sw.R: Huenda mwanamke hana pesa za kutosha kununua mwanakondoo. Basi lazima alete hua wawili au makinda mawili ya njiwa. Mmoja ni kwa sadaka ya kuteketezwa, na mwingine ni kwa sadaka ya dhambi. Kuhani atamfanyia upatanisho, naye atakuwa safi.'"

decisions.choice: her hand does not find enough: she cannot afford it
decisions.reason: "Her hand finds" means she has the means. The law makes room for the poor, as in 5:7 and 14:21. Luke 2:22-24 tells that Mary brought this offering of two birds after Jesus was born.

decisions.choice: one ... and one: the burnt offering and the sin offering both remain
decisions.reason: Even the smaller offering keeps both parts: one bird is burned whole, the other is the sin offering (see 5:7-10).

decisions.choice: cannot afford
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say plainly what the idiom "her hand does not find" means. Literal keeps the idiom.
